title: Node With Highest Edge Score
summary: Given a directed graph with n nodes labeled from 0 to n-1 , where each node has exactly one outgoing edge, determine the node with the highest edge score.
statement: Given a directed graph with n nodes labeled from 0 to n-1 , where each node has exactly one outgoing edge, determine the node with the highest edge score. The edge score of a node i is calculated as the sum of the labels of all nodes that have an edge pointing to i . If there are multiple nodes with the same edge score, return the node with the smallest index.
constraints: Node i contributes its label i to the score of edges[i].
A node’s edge score is the sum of all source labels pointing to it.
Return the smallest node label among those with the maximum score.
reference_solution:
def node_with_highest_edge_score(edges):
    scores=[0]*len(edges)
    for source,target in enumerate(edges):scores[target]+=source
    answer=0
    for node in range(1,len(edges)):
        if scores[node]>scores[answer]:answer=node
    return answer

hints: Accumulate each source label into the score of its destination.
Initialize the answer to node zero.
Scan nodes in increasing order and replace the answer only for a strictly larger score.
Every contribution is added exactly once, and strict replacement preserves the first—and therefore smallest—maximum-score index.
